note: A longitude or latitude outside its range, in every place a position appears (SPEC 4.1, 6.2). Longitude runs from -180 to 180 and latitude from -90 to 90, both bounds included, and a position outside either will not parse. Each takes the remedy SPEC 6.2 gives a position that will not parse in that place: a waypoint and a network point are dropped, a ring vertex drops its area, a segment pip drops its segment, an arc pip drops its arc, a node is dropped and the arc naming it goes with it, and a `turn` drops its highlight. Every value is just past its bound, and the second waypoint sits exactly on the pole and survives, so a reader with an exclusive bound, or with the latitude range applied to longitude, fails. `counts` pins what survives of each container, and `positions` pins that the survivors are the valid ones.
